title: Decision: no AppDataUpdate size cap in mimi-mls
description: mls-extensions-10 §4.6-4.7 sets no limit on update or component data size. Readings: invent a named cap (INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC) or bound whole-message size at the transport. Chosen (Mark): no cap in mimi-mls; the server and agent bound message size at the transport layer; documented in mimi-mls # Limitations.
